proposed=insufficient_evidence, sufficient=False. Only obs_01 (front, left light) exists. It shows a thin vertical dark line with no discontinuity, which matches the fixture-shadow description but cannot be called a shadow without a light change from the same pose. MB-2 is not met either: there is no second light and no discontinuity. PROC-MB-002 (clamp region) does not apply because nothing indicates a clamp covers the face, and the target region was visible. PROC-GEN-003 only gives general technique. The most useful next step is one lighting change from the front pose, preferably to top or diffuse light.

candidates.hypothesis: Fixture shadow (MB-1) vs. surface crack: the dark vertical line may be the fixture arm shadow cast by the left light. Changing the light from the same pose tests whether it moves or disappears.

proposed_action.expected_evidence: Fixture shadow: the vertical line moves position or disappears under top/diffuse light. Crack or surface mark: the line stays at the same place on the part (x about 0.47) under the new light.
proposed_action.rationale: Cheapest single action that separates a light-dependent shadow from a fixed surface feature. Diffuse or top light is recommended by MB-1 and removes cast shadows. Right light would also work, but diffuse is more decisive because it removes the shadow entirely.

candidates.expected_evidence: Shadow predicts the line disappears or moves under diffuse light. A surface feature predicts it stays at the same location on the part.

candidates.hypothesis: Crack (MB-2) vs. surface mark: the line must show a surface discontinuity in a low oblique view. A crack is confirmed only if it persists across lights and shows a raised edge, lip or gap.

proposed_action.expected_evidence: Crack with broken or raised edge: bright lip or gap visible along the line at x about 0.47. Printed mark or stain: no relief, line looks flat. Shadow: line may be absent.
proposed_action.rationale: Oblique low view exaggerates relief, which is the only way to test for a surface discontinuity. MB-2 requires this check before any crack outcome. It is a separate pose from the already-captured front view, so it is not a repeat.

candidates.expected_evidence: Crack predicts a visible bright lip or gap along the line. Mark or seam predicts a flat line with no relief. Shadow predicts no consistent line.

candidates.hypothesis: Covered-region / incomplete coverage: the centre of the face may be hidden under a hold-down clamp, so the line's extent or the absence of a feature there cannot be judged from the front pose alone.

hypotheses_addressed: region under hold-down clamp is uninspected
proposed_action.expected_evidence: If a clamp covers the centre, left_45 reveals a region the front view did not show. If no clamp is present, left_45 shows the same face with the same line position, and the line's relief can be compared.
proposed_action.rationale: Tests whether the bracket has a clamp that blocks inspection of the centre. left_45 is the only pose that sees past the clamp edge, so it is the required view if a clamp exists. It also gives a second angle on the line.

candidates.expected_evidence: Clamp present: new occluded area becomes visible or a clamp edge appears in the image. Clamp absent: no occlusion, line remains visible.
